asciiPanel:
Grant Object Authority (GRTOBJAUT)

Type choices, press Enter.

Object . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . > PAYROLL/PAYMST
Object type . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . > *FILE
Users . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . > APCLERK
Authority . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . > *USE

Bottom
F3=Exit   F4=Prompt   F5=Refresh   F9=All parameters   F12=Cancel
F13=How to use this display   F24=More keys
notes: F4 prompt panel for GRTOBJAUT — OBJ, OBJTYPE, USER, AUT, AUTL parameters per Security Reference. F9 expands to all parameters; F24 shows additional PF keys.
auditNotes: Grant path — auditors verify least privilege; denied GRTOBJAUT should produce QAUDJRN ENTTYP(AF). Lab scenario: APCLERK denied on PAYMST.
